newsitem.title: USA: Triarc unit to sell 355 Arby's restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Triarc unit to sell 355 Arby's restaurants.

text.p: Triarc Cos Inc said on Thursday that its subsidiary Arby's Inc has agreed to sell its 355 company-owned stores to an affiliate of RTM Restaurant Group for $71 million, including the assumption of debt.
Triarc would receive an option to buy a 20 percent interest in the affiliate of RTM, its largest franchisee.
After the sale, RTM would have 670 Arby's stores, out of a total of more than 3,000. RTM would agree to build another 400 Arby's stores over 14 years.

Triarc also said Arby's president and chief executive, Don Pierce, has resigned but will continue with the company as a consultant. Roland Smith, Arby's senior vice president and general manager, was named to replace Pierce.
